missing_fields: Complete supplied four-page main read in text and visually, including Figures 1–3 and 20 printed references. No matching local SI was found in the bounded filename search; cited full sources and any unavailable SI are unreviewed.
Autoclave pressure, atmosphere, heating rate, cooling duration, stirring, filter specification, wash volume/count, vacuum pressure and isolated yield are not reported.

The source gives absolute ethanol at 90% of a 100 mL autoclave capacity; no independently measured 90 mL charge is asserted. Water of crystallization and proposed trace water are not a separate measured water addition.

The successful 160 °C/10 h route is quantitatively specified. Failed precursor/reductant/pre-reduction controls and qualitative temperature/time limits do not report complete separate charges or schedules.

The 20 nm Scherrer mean is distinct from the TEM observation that some particles are below 20 nm and larger features are aggregates. No TEM mean/distribution or measured atomic coordinates is supplied.

Yellow phosphorus is preserved as the source-named elemental charge, including its printed 7.74 mmol amount; no P4 molecular-mole conversion is inferred. The proposed reaction equation uses P4 separately.
